title: A working workshop
summary: Tune carried weapons with salvage and enjoy a more lived-in operations garage.
notes: Use the workbench to turn two scrap pieces and electronics into a permanent 15% damage tune for a stock firearm.
Save upgraded gear and consumed materials together, with a scrolling interface for touch and controller.
Open, stop and close the shared roller door; blocked closing reverses safely and reveals a rainy road with an invisible boundary keeping players inside.
Add quiet radio music, fluorescent hum, motor sounds, occasional light dips, warm task lighting, coffee cups and a coat rack.
